title: Localized 6-Layer Refinement with Reduced Exploration Radius
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing the optimization exploration radius to ±10 nm and concentrating sampling on layers 2-3 (where prior candidates showed greatest divergence from quarter-wave) will refine phase accumulation without boundary collisions, yielding marginal improvement in dual-band reflectance balancing.
design_principle: Local gradient probing around the prior optimum (44.96, 138.94, 161.65, 243.43, 124.89, 37.78 nm) with constrained step size to avoid overshooting the narrow optimum basin.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (6 finite layers, alternating high-low starting with Ta2O5)
soft_objectives: minimize average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
minimize average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method thickness optimization for broadband AR coatings
Modified quarter-wave thickness tuning for dual-band matching
expected_advantages: Focused refinement where prior optimization showed greatest sensitivity
known_risks: May be trapped in local optimum if global structure requires larger moves
Marginal improvement may not justify additional computation
execution_request_english: Optimize a 6-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate. Stack sequence: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si(semi-infinite). Initialize thicknesses from prior best candidate [44.96, 138.94, 161.65, 243.43, 124.89, 37.78] nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with exploration radius ±10 nm per layer. Evaluate unpolarized reflectance and transmittance at 0 deg incidence over 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm bands. Thickness bounds: 20-400 nm per layer. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Reduced exploration radius from prior iteration to ±10 nm and concentrated sampling on layers 2-3 where thickness divergence was greatest, per insight appendage guidance. Initialization from best prior candidate preserves verified optimum basin.
